plugins.name: spec-author
plugins.description: Gated spec authoring for a spec that is not yet approved — an intent.md or spec.md exists.

plugins.name: spec-brainstorming
plugins.description: Five-stage idea co-design and pressure-testing — the pre-spec front door of the suite, for when WHETHER to build it or WHICH version is still open.

plugins.name: spec-code-review
plugins.description: Gated code review for any git repository — a diff, a pull request, a branch, or the whole project.

plugins.name: spec-execute
plugins.description: Builds an approved spec — the suite's back half.

plugins.name: spec-intake
plugins.description: Requirements intake for a settled direction — turns a raw idea (or a spec-brainstorming handoff) into one validated specs/<name>/intent.md: scouts the repo, grills the open questions until none remain, gates the result, stops.
